request.style: English, male baritone, gritty solo, electric guitar, bass, drums, organ, uplifting rock, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Who are you to judge another's servant
He stands or falls before his master
The Lord is able to make him stand
So let each be fully convinced in his mind

[Chorus]
For none of us lives to himself
And none of us dies to himself
If we live we live to the Lord
If we die we die to the Lord
We belong to the Lord

[Verse]
One regards one day above another
Another regards every day alike
Whoever eats does so to the Lord
And whoever abstains gives thanks to God

[Chorus]
For none of us lives to himself
And none of us dies to himself
If we live we live to the Lord
If we die we die to the Lord
We belong to the Lord

[Bridge]
Christ died and returned to life
To be Lord of the dead and living
Why do you judge your brother
Why do you look down on him

[Outro]
We will all stand before the judgment seat
Every knee will bow to the Lord
